subtopicTitle: Isentropic flow tables — P/P₀, T/T₀, ρ/ρ₀ as functions of M

cards.front: State the isentropic relation for the temperature ratio T/T₀(M, γ).
What are the values of T/T₀, P/P₀ and ρ/ρ₀ at M = 0?
State the isentropic relation for the pressure ratio P/P₀(M, γ).
State the isentropic relation for the density ratio ρ/ρ₀(M, γ).
For γ = 1.4, isentropic tables are generated by evaluating which three closed-form expressions over a range of M?
cards.back: T/T₀, P/P₀ and ρ/ρ₀ formulas above.

cards.front: Derive P/P₀ from T/T₀ using the isentropic process relation.
cards.back: p ∝ T^{γ/(γ-1)} ⇒ p/p₀ = (T/T₀)^{γ/(γ-1)}; substitute the T/T₀ expression.

cards.front: Why do T/T₀, P/P₀ and ρ/ρ₀ all → 0 as M → ∞?
cards.back: The term ((γ-1)/2)M² dominates inside the parentheses; the resulting large number raised to a negative power → 0.
